goals: Maintain a private Minecraft Java 26.2 downstream Ribbits build for the fixed Mynx and Matcha stack, preserving upstream behavior except for individually documented intentional Mynx deviations.

Maintain the user-approved tiered Glowcap trade economy, persistent profession progression and daily restocking, exact cross-stack item contracts, and Toadstool Heart home-setting behavior without converting Ribbits into vanilla Villagers.

Maintain the exact Phase C swamp-hut Sorcerer, natural-Witch boundary, shared Ribbit Village explorer-map result, failed-map Sorcerer service, and future-only village utility cleanup without retrofitting existing structures.
Keep every private reconstruction deterministic and hash-guarded while isolating protected Ribbits resources and approved local donor visuals from the public source repository.
scope: Retain the legally trackable faithful-port baseline and maintain the intentional deviations recorded in MYNX_DEVIATIONS.md without changing stable mod, registry, entity, or save identities.

Maintain all nine registered Ribbit professions, the explicit equal-weight eight-member natural village pool, and typed spawn-egg, pick-block, dispenser, codec, persistence, model, texture, and umbrella contracts.

Maintain the cumulative profession trade-profile framework, fixed Glowcap prices, persistent specializations and gates, deterministic Chef menus, two-restocks-per-day policy, and exact component-aware Matcha and Custom Portals stack matching introduced by Mynx Canary 3.

Maintain new-hut-only replacement of the initial swamp-hut Witch with one persistent Sorcerer, independent Cat relocation, an exact-piece natural-Witch rejection, one lazy map barrel, and the marker-authenticated rank-independent failed-map redemption introduced by Mynx Canary 4.

Maintain the exact hash-pinned six-template private NBT transform for future Ribbit village placement while preserving every non-target record, retained utility, storage block, loot binding, and processor sentinel.

Maintain ribbits:glowcap and ribbits:toadstool_heart as permanent mechanical identities while their temporary Warped Fungus and original Crystal Heart visual models await a narrow final-art successor.
Preserve the private resource assembler, exact pristine, Minecraft, dependency, donor, output, and archive identities, and the authorized shared green spawn-egg derivation contract.

exclusions: Protected Ribbits resources, donor-derived models and textures, pristine or donor binaries, private manifests and reports, and the complete private Canary JAR are external, ignored, private-use-only, and nonredistributable.
Public source-only build output is resource-incomplete and must not be represented as a runnable Canary.

No Wandering Ribbit or map sale, automatic Sorcerer replacement, existing-hut or existing-village retrofit, conversion of saved Witches, global Witch suppression, Matcha cartographer or Witch Hut map changes, asynchronous map search, custom map item or GUI, generalized old-offer migration, donor AI, Guard combat AI, home-dimension redesign, Fortune Blessing, Silver Bullion, or Adamant/Netherite economy additions in Canary 4.
No substitute private inputs, deployment, Test Instance Manager mutation, gameplay-profile access, or Minecraft runtime claim from source, build, static, codec, tree, or archive evidence.

state.milestone: Mynx Canary 4 preserves the complete Phase A profession surface and Phase B Glowcap economy while adding Phase C: each newly generated procedural vanilla swamp hut consumes the vanilla Witch one-shot but creates one persistent ribbits:sorcerer at local (3,2,5), keeps and moves only the initial Cat to (2,2,4), and places one north-facing lazy map barrel at (2,2,6). Natural Witch candidates alone are rejected only inside an actual SwampHutPiece of exact minecraft:swamp_hut metadata; existing Witches and non-natural creation paths remain unchanged. The barrel uses ribbits:chests/swamp_hut_map and shared modifier ribbits:ribbit_village_explorer_result for #ribbits:on_ribbit_village_explorer_maps at raw radius 100, zoom 2, plains marker, and skip-existing-chunks false; misses become one exact marked Uncharted Ribbit Map redeemable by every Sorcerer for one Toadstool Heart with 16 uses, zero profession XP, zero multiplier, and no Benzene-gate or rank effect. Six hash-pinned private village templates remove Brewing Stands and Damaged Anvils to air and replace the Smoker and Blast Furnace with Stone Bricks for future placement only while preserving every non-target record. Existing huts/villages are not retrofitted; removing Ribbits can leave a Phase C hut without its consumed initial Witch, and synchronous radius-100 map misses may stall. Exact retained Canary 3 and YUNG's API Compat.2 binaries bind the user's scoped Phase B practical PASS; practical use was sufficient to continue, but the exhaustive trade matrix was not executed and no individual untested row or edge case is marked observed. Canary 3 is not promoted or assigned a managed-slot result. Canary 4 was not deployed or launched and has no runtime evidence.
